scope: Clarification only: original protocol/source/results remain unchanged.
original_protocol_timing_scope: Fresh noise to PIL image plus monochrome WebP; excludes fixed-prompt initialization, load, warmup, HTTP, queueing and any future quality gates
correction: The statement fresh noise to PIL overstates the timed scope. CPU torch.randn noise creation occurs before the timer; its duration was not measured in this run.
actually_timed_generation: Starts immediately before pipeline call; includes CPU-to-MPS transfer/cast of already-created noise, four denoising steps, VAE decode, conversion to PIL and MPS synchronization. Fixed prompt embedding construction and model load are separate initialization.
actually_timed_encoding: Monochrome conversion and WebP encoding only; diagnostic nativePNG save is outside both measured intervals.
summed_total: generation_plus_encoding_seconds sums two intervals separated by an untimed diagnosticPNGwrite. It is a component sum, not continuous full-request wallclock. CPU noise creation, NPZwrite, output-file hashing/record writes, HTTP, queueing, coldstart and future quality gates are not included.
resource_measurement_limit: Run used only per-denoising-step MPSdriver checks; text encoding and VAEdecode peak allocation were not independently sampled. External supervisor RSS is not totalMPSdriver memory. Recorded post-image allocation is not peakallocation.
